source.title: Amodal3R: Amodal 3D Reconstruction from Occluded 2D Images
source.source_path: C:\Users\华硕\Zotero\storage\HL7OPESN\Wu et al. - 2025 - Amodal3R Amodal 3D Reconstruction from Occluded 2D Images.pdf

blocks.original_text: Most image-based 3D object reconstructors assume that objects are fully visible, ignoring occlusions that commonly occur in real-world scenarios.
blocks.translation: 多数基于图像的三维物体重建器假设物体完全可见，忽略了真实场景中普遍存在的遮挡。

blocks.original_text: We consider the problem of reconstructing 3D objects from one or more partially-occluded views, a novel task that we call amodal 3D reconstruction.
blocks.translation: 论文把从一个或多个部分遮挡视角恢复完整三维物体定义为 amodal 3D reconstruction。

blocks.original_text: 2D amodal completion methods rely predominantly on appearance-based priors rather than explicit 3D structural cues.
blocks.translation: 二维非模态补全主要依赖外观先验，而不是显式三维结构线索；这会在复杂遮挡下产生物理上不合理的几何。

blocks.original_text: Amodal3R augments the foundation 3D generator TRELLIS with an additional branch to condition on occlusions.
blocks.translation: Amodal3R 在 TRELLIS 这个 foundation 3D generator 上增加遮挡条件分支，在三维 latent 空间同时处理重建、补全和遮挡推理。

blocks.original_text: The denoising network is trained to minimize the flow loss.
blocks.translation: 模型在 structured 3D latent 上用 flow matching 学习从噪声回到目标 latent 的速度场。

blocks.original_text: We wish to bias the token similarity matrix towards the visible parts of the object.
blocks.translation: visibility mask 被转成 patch 权重并加入 attention logits，使模型优先读取可见目标区域；完全不可见 patch 的权重为零。

blocks.original_text: It is not enough to specify the visible information; instead, we must also differentiate foreground occluders from the background.
blocks.translation: 只标记可见区域还不够，还要把前景遮挡者与背景区分开，因为前者解释了哪些区域可能属于目标却暂时不可见。

blocks.original_text: To efficiently generate such contact occlusion masks, we leverage 3D meshes during rendering.
blocks.translation: 论文利用三维 mesh 的邻接三角形随机游走生成接触遮挡，从而保证同一对象的多视角遮挡模式一致。

blocks.original_text: Amodal3R significantly outperforms the baselines across all metrics in both single- and multi-view 3D reconstruction.
blocks.translation: 在 GSO 与 Toys4K 的单视图和多视图评测中，论文报告 Amodal3R 在渲染、语义一致性和点云几何指标上都优于基线。

blocks.original_text: The full model integrating both modules achieves optimal 3D generation results characterized by complete geometry and consistent textures.
blocks.translation: 消融显示两个模块互补：可见性加权更有利于外观，遮挡感知层更有利于几何，联合模型最稳定。

blocks.original_text: Amodal3R generates reasonable 3D assets on Replica and in-the-wild images.
blocks.translation: Replica 和真实图片结果支持模型的现实可用性，但这些样本缺少完整三维真值，因此不能由视觉合理性推出背面真实性。

blocks.original_text: Completions on some complex or out-of-distribution objects may fail or lead to unrealistic structures.
blocks.translation: 作者承认训练数据规模有限且主要是 furniture，复杂或分布外对象可能失败；真实数据适配和可控补全仍未解决。

glossary.amodal 3D reconstruction: 完整三维对象推断，包含遮挡部分
glossary.mask-weighted cross-attention: 用 visibility patch ratio 调节 attention logits
glossary.occlusion-aware attention: 单独读取 occluder mask 以区分 unknown 与 background
glossary.3D-consistent mask: 跨视角一致的接触遮挡模拟
